# Jay Liu

> Jay Liu (Jie Liu) is a senior software engineer based in Auckland, New Zealand. He builds full-stack software and AI-enabled workflows with C#/.NET, React/TypeScript and Python. His portfolio presents anonymous industry websites, private systems and public open-source tools.

## Public website

- [English portfolio](https://jayliu.co.nz/): Concrete project cases, background, skills, experience and contact details.
- [中文个人网站](https://jayliu.co.nz/zh/): Chinese version of the same personal portfolio.
- [Privacy](https://jayliu.co.nz/privacy/): How this website and contact links handle information.

The private system previews contain no customer records. Public links identify externally accessible websites or open-source repositories; private system endpoints are not published.
